text: For the card: a fresh session was watched in meta_agent/builds/echo/0003/bundle (template v4) on 2026-11-12, on the person's word to this session ('Yes, open it'), with the brief and the level of the watch of 0002 (claude-sonnet-5-5, effort medium; told to write nothing; not told what v4 changed). What it reported and what this seat then read off its own runs in that folder: 'gate: self-check ok'; 'replay: 2 item(s), 2 as expected, 0 not; OK'; 'gates: interface pass, scientific undecided; overall undecided', with a failure status from src/validate_tasks.py; the call of rp-001 through src/run_tool.py returned the message and its length as the item expects; git status in the bundle prints nothing and the bundle's hash equals the build card's. The three faults of v3 did not come back: it loaded run-skill before the call and used its section on a tool no library skill calls; it said the task told it what the failure status means; it reported no sentence about having no skills. It said the folder was enough with nobody to ask. What it met, none of it a failure: run-skill's list of what a session may change speaks of inputs written into the folder for runs, and it piped the input instead because its brief forbade writing, the skill not saying that either is allowed; the bundle's CLAUDE.md says to run the replay and the task validator before and after a task, and it ran them once. One thing it got wrong and this seat checked: it took src/__pycache__ in the bundle for committed; it is not tracked (the repository's .gitignore), it is left on disk by the Designer's own validation run of a new bundle, and the bundle's hash skips it. The same two limits as before stand: opened inside this repository, the session was given the root CLAUDE.md, meta_agent/CLAUDE.md and the Meta-Agent's skills and set them aside on its brief's word; and echo has no library skill, so the runner of skills had nothing to run.
